receipt_and_state_audit.six_primary_solver_entry_seed_admissibil: Existing Green report: all six seeds finite and positive for the checked thermodynamic, dry mass, and geopotential metrics. Independent raw checks confirm baseline/replay/prefix032 x0 equals baseline checkpoint 0, and each FD x0 equals x0 + actual transmitted FP32 eta times v, with published FP32 seed equal to cast of saved FP64 seed.

fortran_cotangent_chain.meaning: Eight actual checked Fortran FP32 pullbacks: baseline's last 32 steps from lambda256 to lambda224, then seven native prefix windows from 224..32 down to solver-entry step 0. Each returned FP32 cotangent is the next window's exact FP32 input.
fortran_cotangent_chain.precision_boundary: Per-window FP64 vectors are local pre-cast diagnostics for their actual FP32 inputs. The only global dAD used is dot(v,g0_fortran_f32 promoted to FP64); no exact-global-FP64 chain is claimed.

independent_raw_recomputation.method: Loaded raw little-endian FP32/FP64 output binaries directly; independently recomputed J=lambda32 promoted to FP64 dot terminal_state64 for all five objective cases, dAD, central FD at both widths using actual transmitted FP32 eta promoted to FP64, width agreement, one-sided slopes, signal floor, FP32 chain continuity, and local cast metrics. No runner/analyzer scalar result was used as the numeric input.
independent_raw_recomputation.frozen_acceptance: Both FD-vs-AD and mutual central-width differences are far below the frozen 1% tolerance. Both signal differences exceed the frozen floor. One-sided gaps are below 1% at both widths.

nonsmoothness_limit.hard_omega_sign_diagnostic: Matching-step/ordinal diagnostics show 55,956 to 166,302 sign disagreements versus baseline across the four perturbed cases, with 9,984 zero-membership changes. Baseline and replay sign traces match exactly.
nonsmoothness_limit.interpretation: These are branch diagnostics, not proof that physical evaluations align or that a derivative fails. The raw one-sided and central FD checks for the one frozen direction and two finite widths agree with the FP32 Fortran chain. Limit conclusions to this direction/setup/finite-width evidence; do not claim general smoothness or all-direction differentiability.

remaining_audit_gate.detail: The n=32 final prefix has warm_steps=0, so the native producer has no warm-to-suffix transition and emits no terminal.suffix_seed_f64.bin. The raw x0_internal_f64 exists, equals baseline checkpoint 0 bytewise, and the prefix checkpoint ledger contains that same step-0 state; the published x0 is its FP32 cast. The offline analyzer currently requires the absent suffix file unconditionally. Green is adjusting only this derived audit to use the already-recorded checkpoint-0 seed when warm_steps=0. No raw file or result was fabricated. Re-run the analyzer and pin its final gate before calling the evidence package fully closed.
